Build an Awwwards-Quality Immersive 3D Website for a Premium Modular Kitchen & Interior Design Company
You are an award-winning creative director, senior UI/UX designer, Three.js engineer, React architect, motion designer, and frontend developer.
Your mission is to build a website that feels like an Awwwards Site of the Day.
This is not a normal corporate website.
The website should feel like an interactive luxury experience that immediately impresses clients and demonstrates world-class design capability.
Objective
Build a fully functional, production-ready website that showcases premium modular kitchens and interior design services.
The website should combine:

* Cinematic storytelling
* Immersive 3D
* Smooth animations
* Interactive product visualization
* Luxury branding
* Fast performance
The visitor should feel like they are exploring a luxury showroom rather than browsing a website.

content.text: This is a huge, ambitious brief — genuinely a multi-week build for a studio team. I can deliver something real and impressive, but I want to aim it correctly before I start. Two quick decisions:

questions.question: What delivery format do you want? (Affects whether you can run it immediately vs. develop it further.)

options.label: Runnable single-file demo (Recommended)
options.description: One self-contained HTML file using Three.js + GSAP via CDN. Opens instantly in any browser — real 3D kitchen, configurator, scroll story, working forms. No install. Best for an immediate 'wow' you can actually see today.

options.label: Full Next.js + R3F repo
options.description: Production project scaffold: TypeScript, Tailwind, React Three Fiber, Framer Motion, Lenis. Clean architecture and components, but you'll need to run npm install locally and I can't visually test it in this environment.

options.label: Both
options.description: Single-file demo now to see it working, plus the Next.js project structure. More files, longer.

questions.question: Photorealistic 3D requires GLTF assets/HDRIs I can't source here. How should I handle the 3D kitchen?

options.label: Procedural 3D built in-code (Recommended)
options.description: A stylized-but-premium kitchen built from Three.js geometry — animated cabinet doors, drawers, lighting toggle, material swaps, rotating island. Fully functional, no external assets, looks polished.

options.label: Asset-ready structure
options.description: Code structured to load real GLTF models + HDRI you supply later, with placeholders. Looks plain until you add assets, but production-accurate pipeline.

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
.serif{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400;line-height:1.02}
section{position:relative;z-index:2}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:#000}

/* ---------- custom cursor ---------- */
#cursor,#cursor-dot{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:difference}
#cursor{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .3s var(--ease),height .3s var(--ease),background .3s}
#cursor-dot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#cursor.grow{width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(246,244,239,.15)}
@media(hover:none){#cursor,#cursor-dot{display:none}}

/* ---------- loading ---------- */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;background:var(--black);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:26px;transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),visibility .8s}
#loader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#loader .mark{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px);letter-spacing:.55em;text-indent:.55em;color:var(--white)}
#loader .bar{width:min(320px,60vw);height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);overflow:hidden}
#loader .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));transition:width .3s linear}
#loader .pct{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- 3D canvas ---------- */
#scene-canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;display:block}
.scene-grad{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 20%,rgba(200,162,76,.10),transparent 55%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,11,12,.0)0%,rgba(11,11,12,.0)60%,rgba(11,11,12,.55)100%)}

/* ---------- navbar ---------- */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:22px clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transition:background .5s var(--ease),padding .5s var(--ease),border-color .5s;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
nav.solid{background:rgba(11,11,12,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--glass-brd);padding:14px clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
nav .logo{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-indent:.42em}
nav .logo b{font-weight:500;color:var(--gold-2)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:34px;list-style:none}
nav ul a{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .3s}
nav ul a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
nav ul a:hover,nav ul a.active{color:var(--white)}
nav ul a:hover::after,nav ul a.active::after{width:100%}
nav .navcta{display:inline-block}
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));color:#1a1407;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:40px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s}
.btn-gold:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(200,162,76,.35)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);padding:13px 26px;border-radius:40px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--white);color:#000}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,7vw,110px)}
.hero .eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:26px;overflow:hidden}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,9vw,140px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero h1 .line{display:block;overflow:hidden}
.hero h1 .line span{display:inline-block;transform:translateY(110%)}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.hero p{max-width:520px;margin:30px 0 40px;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(15px,1.5vw,18px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.7}
.hero .cta-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:34px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.scroll-hint i{width:1px;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),transparent);animation:drop 1.8s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes drop{0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}45%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}55%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}}

/* ---------- story ---------- */
#story{position:relative}
.story-step{height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,7vw,110px);pointer-events:none}
.story-step .inner{max-width:560px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}
.story-step .num{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:18px}
.story-step h2{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,66px)}
.story-step h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.story-step p{margin-top:18px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.7;max-width:440px}
.story-step.right{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.story-step.right p{margin-left:auto}

/* ---------- generic section shell ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(80px,12vh,150px) clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.kicker::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.sec-title{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,72px);max-width:14ch}
.sec-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.solid-bg{background:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:3;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.panel-bg{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--black),#101013);position:relative;z-index:3}

/* ---------- interactive configurator ---------- */
#studio{min-height:100vh;position:relative;z-index:3}
#studio .stage-note{position:absolute;top:50%;left:clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transform:translateY(-50%);max-width:300px;pointer-events:none}
.config-panel{position:fixed;right:clamp(14px,2vw,28px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:60;width:300px;max-width:84vw;
  background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);
  border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s var(--ease),transform .5s var(--ease);
  max-height:84vh;overflow:auto}
.config-panel.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.config-panel h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin:16px 0 10px}
.config-panel h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s;position:relative}
.sw:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.sw.active{border-color:var(--gold)}
.presets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.preset{padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:.3s}
.preset:hover,.preset.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.toggles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin-top:4px}
.tg{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--white)}
.tg button{width:46px;height:24px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.tg button i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);transition:.3s var(--ease)}
.tg button.on{background:rgba(200,162,76,.3);border-color:var(--gold)}
.tg button.on i{left:24px;background:var(--gold-2)}
#spec-tip{position:fixed;z-index:70;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(11,11,12,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;max-width:230px}
#spec-tip b{color:var(--gold-2);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500}
#spec-tip span{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

/* ---------- services ---------- */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:60px}
.svc{padding:30px 26px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .5s,border-color .5s;min-height:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.svc:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:var(--gold)}
.svc .ic{font-size:26px;color:var(--gold-2)}
.svc h3{font-size:23px;margin-top:auto}
.svc p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- portfolio ---------- */
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:40px}
.filters button{padding:9px 20px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:.35s;font-family:inherit}
.filters button:hover,.filters button.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.masonry{columns:3;column-gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
@media(max-width:900px){.masonry{columns:2}}
@media(max-width:560px){.masonry{columns:1}}
.tile{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.tile img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .8s var(--ease);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c1c1f,#2a2620)}
.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.tile .cap{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;padding:30px 20px 16px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.8));
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
.tile:hover .cap{opacity:1;transform:none}
.tile .cap b{font-weight:500;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.tile .cap span{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-top:4px}

/* lightbox */
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:rgba(7,7,8,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
#lightbox.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
#lightbox img{max-width:86vw;max-height:80vh;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#lightbox .lb-close{position:absolute;top:26px;right:30px;font-size:30px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none}
#lightbox .lb-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:34px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:20px}
#lightbox .prev{left:10px}#lightbox .next{right:10px}

/* ---------- before/after ---------- */
.ba{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:980px;margin:50px auto 0;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
.ba img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ba .after{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 50%)}
.ba .handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:2px;background:var(--gold);cursor:ew-resize;z-index:5}
.ba .handle::after{content:'⟺';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--gold);color:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px}
.ba .lbl{position:absolute;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;z-index:4}
.ba .lbl.b{left:16px}.ba .lbl.a{right:16px;color:var(--gold-2)}

/* ---------- process timeline ---------- */
.timeline{position:relative;margin-top:60px;padding-left:30px}
.timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),transparent)}
.tl{position:relative;padding:0 0 42px 36px;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-24px)}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-30px;top:4px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--black);border:2px solid var(--gold)}
.tl .step{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold-2);text-transform:uppercase}
.tl h3{font-size:26px;margin:6px 0}
.tl p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:300;max-width:520px;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:50px}
@media(max-width:860px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.stat{text-align:center;padding:24px 10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.stat:first-child{border-left:none}
.stat .n{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);color:var(--white)}
.stat .n em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold-2)}
.stat .l{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}

/* ---------- testimonials ---------- */
.tcar{margin-top:50px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.ttrack{display:flex;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.tcard{min-width:100%;padding:0 6px}
.tcard .inner{background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);
  border-radius:20px;padding:44px clamp(24px,5vw,60px);text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.tcard .stars{color:var(--gold-2);letter-spacing:.3em;margin-bottom:20px}
.tcard q{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,30px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;display:block}
.tcard .who{margin-top:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px}
.tcard .who img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#2a2620}
.tcard .who b{font-weight:500}.tcard .who span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold-2);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tdots{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;margin-top:28px}
.tdots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.tdots i.on{background:var(--gold);width:24px;border-radius:8px}

/* ---------- contact ---------- */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;margin-top:50px}
@media(max-width:840px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}}
.form-field{margin-bottom:18px}
.form-field label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.form-field input,.form-field select,.form-field textarea{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:10px;
  padding:13px 15px;color:var(--white);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;transition:.3s}
.form-field input:focus,.form-field select:focus,.form-field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.form-field.err input,.form-field.err select,.form-field.err textarea{border-color:#c0593f}
.form-field .msg{font-size:11px;color:#e08a72;margin-top:6px;display:none}
.form-field.err .msg{display:block}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.form-ok{background:rgba(200,162,76,.12);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold-2);display:none;margin-bottom:18px}
.contact-info p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;margin-top:14px}
.contact-info .row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:22px}
.contact-info .row b{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em}
.map{margin-top:26px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(.85)}
.map iframe{width:100%;height:230px;border:0;display:block}

/* ---------- floating buttons ---------- */
.floaters{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:800;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.fab{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transition:transform .3s var(--ease);font-size:22px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
.fab:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.fab.wa{background:#25d366}.fab.call{background:#1f1f22;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd)}
.fab.top{background:var(--gold);color:#000;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.fab.top.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:3;padding:70px clamp(20px,5vw,60px) 30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.fgrid{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr;gap:40px}
@media(max-width:840px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.fgrid h5{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:18px}
.fgrid a{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:11px;transition:.3s;font-weight:300}
.fgrid a:hover{color:var(--white);padding-left:5px}
.fbrand .logo{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.4em;margin-bottom:18px}
.fbrand p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;max-width:280px}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.socials a{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-color:var(--gold);padding:0}
.fbottom{max-width:1280px;margin:50px auto 0;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.05em}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}
@media(max-width:820px){
  nav ul,.navcta{display:none}
  .menu-btn{display:block}
  .config-panel{right:10px;width:260px}
  .stat{border-left:none}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.001s!important;transition-duration:.001s!important}}
</style>
</head>

  <ul>
    <li><a href="#studio">Showroom</a></li>

    <li><a href="#portfolio">Portfolio</a></li>

  <button class="btn btn-gold navcta magnetic" data-scroll="#contact">Book Consultation</button>

  <div class="cta-row" data-hero>
    <button class="btn btn-gold magnetic" data-scroll="#contact">Book Free Consultation</button>

  </div>

addWarm(0,2.55,-3.2,8,7);     // under wall units

  top:  [ {n:'Carrara Marble',c:0xe9e6df,r:.18,m:.0}, {n:'Black Granite',c:0x101012,r:.15,m:.2}, {n:'Quartz Sand',c:0xcabfa8,r:.3,m:.0}, {n:'Brushed Gold',c:0xc8a24c,r:.25,m:.85}, {n:'Concrete',c:0x8c8a86,r:.6,m:.0} ],
  bsp:  [ {n:'Marble Slab',c:0xddd8cd,r:.2,m:.0}, {n:'Smoked Glass',c:0x2a2d33,r:.05,m:.3}, {n:'Brass Tile',c:0xb8923f,r:.3,m:.7}, {n:'White Subway',c:0xf2efe8,r:.3,m:.0} ],
  flr:  [ {n:'Walnut Plank',c:0x4a3022,r:.5,m:.0}, {n:'Oak Plank',c:0xb59264,r:.55,m:.0}, {n:'Marble Floor',c:0xcfcabd,r:.2,m:.05}, {n:'Charcoal',c:0x1b1b1d,r:.45,m:.05} ],
  wall: [ {n:'Warm White',c:0xe8e2d6,r:.9,m:.0}, {n:'Greige',c:0xb8ae9d,r:.9,m:.0}, {n:'Charcoal',c:0x222225,r:.9,m:.0}, {n:'Clay',c:0xa9755a,r:.9,m:.0} ]
};

const M = {
  cab: mat(PALETTE.cab[0]), top: mat(PALETTE.top[0]), bsp: mat(PALETTE.bsp[0]),
  flr: mat(PALETTE.flr[0]), wall: mat(PALETTE.wall[0]),
  handle: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc8a24c,roughness:.25,metalness:.9}),
  steel: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xb8bcc0,roughness:.25,metalness:.85}),
  glass: new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({color:0xbfd0d8,roughness:.05,metalness:0,transmission:.9,transparent:true,opacity:.5,ior:1.4})
};

/* ---------------- kitchen build ---------------- */
const kitchen = new THREE.Group(); scene.add(kitchen);
const box=(w,h,d,m)=>{const g=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),m);g.castShadow=true;g.receiveShadow=true;return g;};

// floor + walls
const floor=box(40,.1,40,M.flr); floor.position.y=-.05; floor.receiveShadow=true; kitchen.add(floor);
const backWall=box(20,8,.2,M.wall); backWall.position.set(0,3.9,-4.1); kitchen.add(backWall);
const sideWall=box(.2,8,20,M.wall); sideWall.position.set(-7,3.9,0); kitchen.add(sideWall);

const frameMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x141414,roughness:.4,metalness:.2});
[[4.4,.12,2.85],[ .12,3,2.85]].forEach(()=>{});
const winFrameT=box(4.6,.14,.12,frameMat);winFrameT.position.set(4.2,5.75,-3.98);kitchen.add(winFrameT);

const winFrameM=box(.12,3,.12,frameMat);winFrameM.position.set(4.2,4.2,-3.98);kitchen.add(winFrameM);

// cabinet doors / drawers registries for animation
const doors=[]; const drawers=[]; const appliances=[];

// ---- base run along back wall ----
function baseUnit(x,withDrawers){
  const g=new THREE.Group(); g.position.set(x,0,-3.35);
  const carcass=box(1.18,1.7,1.0,M.cab); carcass.position.y=.86; g.add(carcass);
  if(withDrawers){
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
      const dr=new THREE.Group(); dr.position.set(0,.42+i*.5,.5);
      const front=box(1.12,.46,.06,M.cab); dr.add(front);
      const h=box(.34,.05,.05,M.handle); h.position.set(0,.16,.04); dr.add(h);
      dr.userData={closedZ:.5,open:false}; g.add(dr); drawers.push(dr);
    }
  } else {
    // two hinged doors
    [-1,1].forEach(side=>{
      const pivot=new THREE.Group(); pivot.position.set(side*0.56,.86,.5);
      const door=box(.54,1.5,.05,M.cab); door.position.x=-side*0.27; pivot.add(door);
      const h=box(.05,.34,.05,M.handle); h.position.set(side*0.18,0,.04); pivot.add(h);
      pivot.userData={side,open:false,type:'door'}; g.add(pivot); doors.push(pivot);
    });
  }
  return g;
}
[-2.4,-1.1, 1.1, 2.4].forEach((x,i)=>kitchen.add(baseUnit(x, i===1||i===2)));

// countertop slab
const counter=box(6.2,.12,1.06,M.top); counter.position.set(0,1.74,-3.35); kitchen.add(counter);

[-2,-.7,.7,2].forEach((x)=>{

});

// ---- appliances ----

fridge.userData={spec:['Built-in Refrigerator','French-door · 600L · no-frost · inverter']}; kitchen.add(fridge);kitchen.add(fh1);kitchen.add(fh2); appliances.push(fridge);
// sink

// ---- island (rotatable) with drawers ----

for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
  const dr=new THREE.Group(); dr.position.set(-.7,.5+i*.45,.66);

function lerpCam(){
  if(interactive) return;
  const f=camProxy.i, i=Math.floor(f), k=Math.min(i+1,camPath.length-1), a=f-i;
  const A=camPath[i], B=camPath[k];
  camera.position.set(
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[0],B.p[0],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[1],B.p[1],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[2],B.p[2],a));
  const tx=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[0],B.t[0],a),
        ty=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[1],B.t[1],a),
        tz=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[2],B.t[2],a);
  // mouse parallax
  camera.position.x+=mouse.x*0.5; camera.position.y+=mouse.y*0.25;
  camera.lookAt(tx,ty,tz);
}

const clock=new THREE.Clock();

  for(let i=1;i<pp.length;i+=3){pp[i]+=dt*0.08;if(pp[i]>6)pp[i]=0;}

}

  ['★★★★★','We renovated our entire apartment with Atelier Noir. Calm, elegant, and built to last. Highly recommend.','Vikram Shah','Pune']
];
const track=document.getElementById('ttrack'),dots=document.getElementById('tdots');let ti=0;
revs.forEach((r,i)=>{const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='tcard';
  c.innerHTML=`<div class="inner"><div class="stars">${r[0]}</div><q>${r[2_0=r[1]||r[1]}</q><div class="who"><img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/96?img=${i+12}" alt="${r[2]}"/><div><b>${r[2]}</b><span>${r[3]}</span></div></div></div>`;
  track.appendChild(c);
  const dt=document.createElement('i');if(i===0)dt.classList.add('on');dt.onclick=()=>go(i);dots.appendChild(dt);});
function go(i){ti=i;track.style.transform=`translateX(-${i*100}%)`;[...dots.children].forEach((d,x)=>d.classList.toggle('on',x===i));}
let tAuto=setInterval(()=>go((ti+1)%revs.length),5000);
track.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>clearInterval(tAuto));
track.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>tAuto=setInterval(()=>go((ti+1)%revs.length),5000));

/* ---- CONTACT FORM validation ---- */
const f=document.getElementById('cform');
const rules={
  name:v=>v.trim().length>1,
  phone:v=>/^[+\d][\d\s-]{6,}$/.test(v.trim()),
  email:v=>/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(v.trim()),
  location:v=>v.trim().length>1,
  ptype:v=>v!=='', budget:v=>v!=='', message:v=>v.trim().length>4
};
f.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();let ok=true;
  Object.keys(rules).forEach(k=>{const inp=f.elements[k];const field=inp.closest('.form-field');
    const valid=rules[k](inp.value);field.classList.toggle('err',!valid);if(!valid)ok=false;});
  if(ok){document.getElementById('formOk').style.display='block';f.reset();
    gsap.fromTo('#formOk',{opacity:0,y:-8},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.5});
    setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('formOk').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}),100);}
});
f.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(inp=>inp.addEventListener('input',()=>{
  const k=inp.name;if(rules[k])inp.closest('.form-field').classList.toggle('err',!rules[k](inp.value));}));
})();
</script>
</body>

:root{

  --marble:#e9e6df; --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.06); --glass-brd:rgba(255,255,255,.14);

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
.serif{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400;line-height:1.02}
section{position:relative;z-index:2}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:#000}

/* ---------- custom cursor ---------- */
#cursor,#cursor-dot{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:difference}
#cursor{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .3s var(--ease),height .3s var(--ease),background .3s}
#cursor-dot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#cursor.grow{width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(246,244,239,.15)}
@media(hover:none){#cursor,#cursor-dot{display:none}}

/* ---------- loading ---------- */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;background:var(--black);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:26px;transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),visibility .8s}
#loader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#loader .mark{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px);letter-spacing:.55em;text-indent:.55em;color:var(--white)}
#loader .bar{width:min(320px,60vw);height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);overflow:hidden}
#loader .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));transition:width .3s linear}
#loader .pct{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- 3D canvas ---------- */
#scene-canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;display:block}
.scene-grad{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 20%,rgba(200,162,76,.10),transparent 55%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,11,12,.0)0%,rgba(11,11,12,.0)60%,rgba(11,11,12,.55)100%)}

/* ---------- navbar ---------- */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:22px clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transition:background .5s var(--ease),padding .5s var(--ease),border-color .5s;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
nav.solid{background:rgba(11,11,12,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--glass-brd);padding:14px clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
nav .logo{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-indent:.42em}
nav .logo b{font-weight:500;color:var(--gold-2)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:34px;list-style:none}
nav ul a{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .3s}
nav ul a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
nav ul a:hover,nav ul a.active{color:var(--white)}
nav ul a:hover::after,nav ul a.active::after{width:100%}
nav .navcta{display:inline-block}
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));color:#1a1407;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:40px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s}

.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--white);color:#000}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,7vw,110px)}

@keyframes drop{0%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top}45%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:top}55%{transform:scaleY(1);transform-origin:bottom}100%{transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom}}

/* ---------- story ---------- */
#story{position:relative}
.story-step{height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,7vw,110px);pointer-events:none}
.story-step .inner{max-width:560px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}

.story-step.right{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}
.story-step.right p{margin-left:auto}

/* ---------- generic section shell ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(80px,12vh,150px) clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.kicker::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.sec-title{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,72px);max-width:14ch}
.sec-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.solid-bg{background:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:3;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.panel-bg{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--black),#101013);position:relative;z-index:3}

/* ---------- interactive configurator ---------- */
#studio{min-height:100vh;position:relative;z-index:3}
#studio .stage-note{position:absolute;top:50%;left:clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transform:translateY(-50%);max-width:300px;pointer-events:none}
.config-panel{position:fixed;right:clamp(14px,2vw,28px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:60;width:300px;max-width:84vw;
  background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);
  border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s var(--ease),transform .5s var(--ease);
  max-height:84vh;overflow:auto}
.config-panel.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.config-panel h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin:16px 0 10px}
.config-panel h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s;position:relative}
.sw:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.sw.active{border-color:var(--gold)}
.presets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.preset{padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:.3s}
.preset:hover,.preset.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.toggles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin-top:4px}
.tg{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--white)}
.tg button{width:46px;height:24px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.tg button i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);transition:.3s var(--ease)}
.tg button.on{background:rgba(200,162,76,.3);border-color:var(--gold)}
.tg button.on i{left:24px;background:var(--gold-2)}
#spec-tip{position:fixed;z-index:70;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(11,11,12,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;max-width:230px}
#spec-tip b{color:var(--gold-2);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500}
#spec-tip span{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

/* ---------- services ---------- */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:60px}
.svc{padding:30px 26px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .5s,border-color .5s;min-height:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.svc:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:var(--gold)}
.svc .ic{font-size:26px;color:var(--gold-2)}
.svc h3{font-size:23px;margin-top:auto}
.svc p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- portfolio ---------- */
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:40px}
.filters button{padding:9px 20px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);

.filters button:hover,.filters button.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.masonry{columns:3;column-gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
@media(max-width:900px){.masonry{columns:2}}
@media(max-width:560px){.masonry{columns:1}}
.tile{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.tile img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .8s var(--ease);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c1c1f,#2a2620)}
.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.tile .cap{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;padding:30px 20px 16px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.8));
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
.tile:hover .cap{opacity:1;transform:none}
.tile .cap b{font-weight:500;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.tile .cap span{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-top:4px}

/* lightbox */
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:rgba(7,7,8,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
#lightbox.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
#lightbox img{max-width:86vw;max-height:80vh;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#lightbox .lb-close{position:absolute;top:26px;right:30px;font-size:30px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none}
#lightbox .lb-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:34px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:20px}
#lightbox .prev{left:10px}#lightbox .next{right:10px}

/* ---------- before/after ---------- */
.ba{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:980px;margin:50px auto 0;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
.ba img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ba .after{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 50%)}
.ba .handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:2px;background:var(--gold);cursor:ew-resize;z-index:5}
.ba .handle::after{content:'⟺';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--gold);color:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px}
.ba .lbl{position:absolute;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;z-index:4}
.ba .lbl.b{left:16px}.ba .lbl.a{right:16px;color:var(--gold-2)}

/* ---------- process timeline ---------- */
.timeline{position:relative;margin-top:60px;padding-left:30px}
.timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),transparent)}
.tl{position:relative;padding:0 0 42px 36px;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-24px)}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-30px;top:4px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--black);border:2px solid var(--gold)}

.tl h3{font-size:26px;margin:6px 0}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:50px}
@media(max-width:860px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.stat{text-align:center;padding:24px 10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

.stat .l{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}

/* ---------- testimonials ---------- */
.tcar{margin-top:50px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}

.tcard q{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,30px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;display:block}
.tcard .who{margin-top:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px}
.tcard .who img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#2a2620}
.tcard .who b{font-weight:500}.tcard .who span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold-2);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tdots{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;margin-top:28px}
.tdots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}

function lerpCam(){
  if(interactive) return;
  const f=camProxy.i, i=Math.floor(f), k=Math.min(i+1,camPath.length-1), a=f-i;
  const A=camPath[i], B=camPath[k];
  camera.position.set(
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[0],B.p[0],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[1],B.p[1],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[2],B.p[2],a));
  const tx=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[0],B.t[0],a),
        ty=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[1],B.t[1],a),
        tz=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[2],B.t[2],a);
  // mouse parallax
  camera.position.x+=mouse.x*0.5; camera.position.y+=mouse.y*0.25;
  camera.lookAt(tx,ty,tz);
}

  gsap.from(d,{opacity:0,y:50,duration:.7,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:d,start:'top 90%'},delay:(i%4)*0.06});
});

/* ---- PORTFOLIO ---- */
const imgIds=['1556909114-f6e7ad7d3136','1600585154340-be6161a56a0c','1600210492486-724fe5c67fb0','1600607687939-ce8a6c25118c','1600566753086-00f18fb6b3ea','1556912173-3bb406ef7e77','1565538810643-b5bdb714032a','1616486338812-3dadae4b4ace','1583847268964-b28dc8f51f92','1631679706909-1844bbd07221','1617104551722-3b2d51366400','1618221195710-dd6b41faaea6'];
const cats=['Kitchen','Living Room','Bedroom','Kitchen','Apartment','Villa','Office','Living Room','Bedroom','Kitchen','Villa','Apartment'];
const names=['Marble & Walnut Kitchen','Penthouse Living','Master Suite','Island Kitchen','Skyline Apartment','Hillside Villa','Studio Office','Garden Lounge','Quiet Bedroom','Dark Edition Kitchen','Coastal Villa','City Apartment'];
const mEl=document.getElementById('masonry');
imgIds.forEach((id,i)=>{
  const t=document.createElement('div');t.className='tile';t.dataset.cat=cats[i];
  const url=`https://images.unsplash.com/photo-${id}?w=700&q=80`;
  t.innerHTML=`<img loading="lazy" src="${url}" alt="${names[i]}" data-full="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-${id}?w=1600&q=85"/><div class="cap"><b>${names[i]}</b><span>${cats[i]}</span></div>`;
  mEl.appendChild(t);
  const img=t.querySelector('img');
  img.onerror=()=>{img.style.aspectRatio='4/3';img.removeAttribute('src');};
});
// hover tilt
mEl.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('.tile');if(!t)return;
  const r=t.getBoundingClientRect();const px=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,py=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
  gsap.to(t,{rotateY:px*8,rotateX:-py*8,duration:.4,ease:'power2.out',transformPerspective:800});});
mEl.addEventListener('mouseleave',e=>{const t=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.tile');});
mEl.querySelectorAll('.tile').forEach(t=>t.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>gsap.to(t,{rotateX:0,rotateY:0,duration:.5})));
// filters
document.querySelectorAll('#filters button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('#filters button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));b.classList.add('active');
  const f=b.dataset.f;
  mEl.querySelectorAll('.tile').forEach(t=>{const show=f==='all'||t.dataset.cat===f;
    gsap.to(t,{opacity:show?1:0,scale:show?1:.9,duration:.4});t.style.display=show?'':'none';});
});
// lightbox
const lb=document.getElementById('lightbox'),lbImg=document.getElementById('lbImg');let gallery=[],gi=0;
function openLB(i){gallery=[...mEl.querySelectorAll('.tile:not([style*="display: none"]) img')];gi=i;showLB();lb.classList.add('show');}
function showLB(){const im=gallery[gi];if(im)lbImg.src=im.dataset.full||im.src;}
mEl.querySelectorAll('.tile').forEach((t,i)=>t.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const vis=[...mEl.querySelectorAll('.tile')].filter(x=>x.style.display!=='none');openLB(vis.indexOf(t));}));
document.getElementById('lbClose').onclick=()=>lb.classList.remove('show');
document.getElementById('lbNext').onclick=()=>{gi=(gi+1)%gallery.length;showLB();};
document.getElementById('lbPrev').onclick=()=>{gi=(gi-1+gallery.length)%gallery.length;showLB();};
lb.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===lb)lb.classList.remove('show');});
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!lb.classList.contains('show'))return;
  if(e.key==='Escape')lb.classList.remove('show');if(e.key==='ArrowRight')document.getElementById('lbNext').click();if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')document.getElementById('lbPrev').click();});

/* ---- BEFORE / AFTER ---- */
(function(){const ba=document.getElementById('ba'),after=ba.querySelector('.after'),handle=document.getElementById('baHandle');
let drag=false;
function set(x){const r=ba.getBoundingClientRect();let p=(x-r.left)/r.width;p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p));
  after.style.clipPath=`inset(0 0 0 ${p*100}%)`;handle.style.left=p*100+'%';}
handle.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>drag=true);
addEventListener('pointerup',()=>drag=false);
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(drag)set(e.clientX);});
ba.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target!==handle)set(e.clientX);});
})();

/* ---- PROCESS TIMELINE ---- */
const steps=[
  ['01','Consultation','We listen — to your space, your habits, your taste.'],
  ['02','Measurements','Laser-precise site survey down to the millimetre.'],
  ['03','Design','Layouts and concepts tailored to how you live.'],
  ['04','3D Visualisation','Walk your kitchen before a single panel is cut.'],
  ['05','Material Selection','Hand-picked finishes, samples to your door.'],
  ['06','Manufacturing','German hardware, furniture-grade fabrication.'],
  ['07','Installation','White-glove fitting by our own craftsmen.'],
  ['08','Quality Check','A 40-point inspection before we hand over.'],
  ['09','Delivery','Your finished space — the heart of your home.']
];
const tl=document.getElementById('timeline');
steps.forEach(s=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tl';
  d.innerHTML=`<div class="step">${s[0]} · ${s[1]}</div><h3 class="serif">${s[1]}</h3><p>${s[2]}</p>`;tl.appendChild(d);
  gsap.to(d,{opacity:1,x:0,duration:.7,ease:'power3.out',scrollTrigger:{trigger:d,start:'top 88%'}});});

/* ---- STATS counters ---- */
document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el=>{
  const end=parseFloat(el.dataset.count),dec=+el.dataset.dec||0;
  window.ScrollTrigger.create({trigger:el,start:'top 90%',once:true,onEnter:()=>{
    gsap.to({v:0},{v:end,duration:2,ease:'power2.out',onUpdate:function(){el.textContent=this.targets()[0].v.toFixed(dec);}});}});
});

/* ---- TESTIMONIALS ---- */
const revs=[
  ['★★★★★','The team translated a vague idea into the most beautiful kitchen we have ever seen. Flawless from concept to install.','Ananya & Rohit Mehra','Gurugram'],
  ['★★★★★','Furniture-grade quality, German hardware, and a process that actually respected our timeline. Worth every rupee.','Karan Malhotra','Mumbai'],
  ['★★★★★','The 3D visualisation sold us — and the finished home looked exactly like it. Obsessive attention to detail.','Dr. Priya Nair','Bengaluru'],
  ['★★★★★','We renovated our entire apartment with Atelier Noir. Calm, elegant, and built to last. Highly recommend.','Vikram Shah','Pune']
];
const track=document.getElementById('ttrack'),dots=document.getElementById('tdots');let ti=0;
revs.forEach((r,i)=>{const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='tcard';
  c.innerHTML=`<div class="inner"><div class="stars">${r[0]}</div><q>${r[2_0=r[1]||r[1]}</q><div class="who"><img src="https://i.pravatar.cc/96?img=${i+12}" alt="${r[2]}"/><div><b>${r[2]}</b><span>${r[3]}</span></div></div></div>`;
  track.appendChild(c);
  const dt=document.createElement('i');if(i===0)dt.classList.add('on');dt.onclick=()=>go(i);dots.appendChild(dt);});
function go(i){ti=i;track.style.transform=`translateX(-${i*100}%)`;[...dots.children].forEach((d,x)=>d.classList.toggle('on',x===i));}
let tAuto=setInterval(()=>go((ti+1)%revs.length),5000);
track.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>clearInterval(tAuto));
track.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>tAuto=setInterval(()=>go((ti+1)%revs.length),5000));

/* ---- CONTACT FORM validation ---- */
const f=document.getElementById('cform');
const rules={
  name:v=>v.trim().length>1,
  phone:v=>/^[+\d][\d\s-]{6,}$/.test(v.trim()),
  email:v=>/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(v.trim()),
  location:v=>v.trim().length>1,
  ptype:v=>v!=='', budget:v=>v!=='', message:v=>v.trim().length>4
};
f.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();let ok=true;
  Object.keys(rules).forEach(k=>{const inp=f.elements[k];const field=inp.closest('.form-field');
    const valid=rules[k](inp.value);field.classList.toggle('err',!valid);if(!valid)ok=false;});
  if(ok){document.getElementById('formOk').style.display='block';f.reset();
    gsap.fromTo('#formOk',{opacity:0,y:-8},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:.5});
    setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('formOk').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'}),100);}
});
f.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(inp=>inp.addEventListener('input',()=>{
  const k=inp.name;if(rules[k])inp.closest('.form-field').classList.toggle('err',!rules[k](inp.value));}));
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<style>
:root{
  --black:#0b0b0c; --ink:#141416; --white:#f6f4ef; --muted:#9a958c;
  --walnut:#5b3a29; --oak:#c9a875; --gold:#c8a24c; --gold-2:#e6c989;
  --marble:#e9e6df; --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.06); --glass-brd:rgba(255,255,255,.14);

}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{background:var(--black);color:var(--white);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
.serif{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400;line-height:1.02}
section{position:relative;z-index:2}
::selection{background:var(--gold);color:#000}

/* ---------- custom cursor ---------- */
#cursor,#cursor-dot{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;border-radius:50%;mix-blend-mode:difference}
#cursor{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .3s var(--ease),height .3s var(--ease),background .3s}
#cursor-dot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--white);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#cursor.grow{width:74px;height:74px;background:rgba(246,244,239,.15)}
@media(hover:none){#cursor,#cursor-dot{display:none}}

/* ---------- loading ---------- */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;background:var(--black);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:26px;transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),visibility .8s}
#loader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#loader .mark{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,52px);letter-spacing:.55em;text-indent:.55em;color:var(--white)}
#loader .bar{width:min(320px,60vw);height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);overflow:hidden}
#loader .bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));transition:width .3s linear}
#loader .pct{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- 3D canvas ---------- */
#scene-canvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;display:block}
.scene-grad{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 20%,rgba(200,162,76,.10),transparent 55%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,11,12,.0)0%,rgba(11,11,12,.0)60%,rgba(11,11,12,.55)100%)}

/* ---------- navbar ---------- */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;z-index:1000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:22px clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transition:background .5s var(--ease),padding .5s var(--ease),border-color .5s;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
nav.solid{background:rgba(11,11,12,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--glass-brd);padding:14px clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
nav .logo{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-indent:.42em}
nav .logo b{font-weight:500;color:var(--gold-2)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:34px;list-style:none}
nav ul a{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .3s}
nav ul a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transition:width .35s var(--ease)}
nav ul a:hover,nav ul a.active{color:var(--white)}
nav ul a:hover::after,nav ul a.active::after{width:100%}
nav .navcta{display:inline-block}
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;border:none;font-family:inherit}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--gold),var(--gold-2));color:#1a1407;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:40px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:500;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s}
.btn-gold:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(200,162,76,.35)}

.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--white);color:#000}
.menu-btn{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,7vw,110px)}

.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}

.hero .cta-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:34px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px}

/* ---------- story ---------- */
#story{position:relative}

.story-step.right{justify-content:flex-end;text-align:right}

/* ---------- generic section shell ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(80px,12vh,150px) clamp(20px,5vw,60px)}
.kicker{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.kicker::before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.sec-title{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,72px);max-width:14ch}
.sec-title em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-2)}
.solid-bg{background:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:3;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.panel-bg{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--black),#101013);position:relative;z-index:3}

/* ---------- interactive configurator ---------- */
#studio{min-height:100vh;position:relative;z-index:3}
#studio .stage-note{position:absolute;top:50%;left:clamp(20px,5vw,60px);transform:translateY(-50%);max-width:300px;pointer-events:none}
.config-panel{position:fixed;right:clamp(14px,2vw,28px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:60;width:300px;max-width:84vw;
  background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);
  border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .5s var(--ease),transform .5s var(--ease);
  max-height:84vh;overflow:auto}
.config-panel.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.config-panel h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin:16px 0 10px}
.config-panel h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sw{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s;position:relative}
.sw:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.sw.active{border-color:var(--gold)}
.presets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.preset{padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:.3s}
.preset:hover,.preset.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.toggles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;margin-top:4px}
.tg{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--white)}
.tg button{width:46px;height:24px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.tg button i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);transition:.3s var(--ease)}
.tg button.on{background:rgba(200,162,76,.3);border-color:var(--gold)}
.tg button.on i{left:24px;background:var(--gold-2)}
#spec-tip{position:fixed;z-index:70;pointer-events:none;background:rgba(11,11,12,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;max-width:230px}
#spec-tip b{color:var(--gold-2);display:block;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500}
#spec-tip span{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}

/* ---------- services ---------- */
.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:60px}
.svc{padding:30px 26px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:18px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .5s,border-color .5s;min-height:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.svc:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:var(--gold)}
.svc .ic{font-size:26px;color:var(--gold-2)}
.svc h3{font-size:23px;margin-top:auto}
.svc p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- portfolio ---------- */
.filters{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:40px}
.filters button{padding:9px 20px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);background:transparent;color:var(--muted);
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:.35s;font-family:inherit}
.filters button:hover,.filters button.active{background:var(--white);color:#000;border-color:var(--white)}
.masonry{columns:3;column-gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
@media(max-width:900px){.masonry{columns:2}}
@media(max-width:560px){.masonry{columns:1}}
.tile{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;cursor:pointer;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
.tile img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .8s var(--ease);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c1c1f,#2a2620)}
.tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.08)}
.tile .cap{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;padding:30px 20px 16px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.8));
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
.tile:hover .cap{opacity:1;transform:none}
.tile .cap b{font-weight:500;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.03em}
.tile .cap span{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-top:4px}

/* lightbox */
#lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:rgba(7,7,8,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
#lightbox.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
#lightbox img{max-width:86vw;max-height:80vh;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#lightbox .lb-close{position:absolute;top:26px;right:30px;font-size:30px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none}
#lightbox .lb-nav{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:34px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:20px}
#lightbox .prev{left:10px}#lightbox .next{right:10px}

/* ---------- before/after ---------- */
.ba{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:980px;margin:50px auto 0;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
.ba img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ba .after{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 50%)}
.ba .handle{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;width:2px;background:var(--gold);cursor:ew-resize;z-index:5}
.ba .handle::after{content:'⟺';position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--gold);color:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px}
.ba .lbl{position:absolute;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;z-index:4}
.ba .lbl.b{left:16px}.ba .lbl.a{right:16px;color:var(--gold-2)}

/* ---------- process timeline ---------- */
.timeline{position:relative;margin-top:60px;padding-left:30px}
.timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),transparent)}
.tl{position:relative;padding:0 0 42px 36px;opacity:0;transform:translateX(-24px)}
.tl::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-30px;top:4px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--black);border:2px solid var(--gold)}
.tl .step{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold-2);text-transform:uppercase}
.tl h3{font-size:26px;margin:6px 0}
.tl p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:300;max-width:520px;line-height:1.6}

/* ---------- stats ---------- */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:50px}
@media(max-width:860px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.stat{text-align:center;padding:24px 10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.stat:first-child{border-left:none}
.stat .n{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,64px);color:var(--white)}
.stat .n em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold-2)}
.stat .l{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}

/* ---------- testimonials ---------- */
.tcar{margin-top:50px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.ttrack{display:flex;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.tcard{min-width:100%;padding:0 6px}
.tcard .inner{background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);
  border-radius:20px;padding:44px clamp(24px,5vw,60px);text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.tcard .stars{color:var(--gold-2);letter-spacing:.3em;margin-bottom:20px}
.tcard q{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,30px);font-style:italic;line-height:1.5;display:block}
.tcard .who{margin-top:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px}
.tcard .who img{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;background:#2a2620}
.tcard .who b{font-weight:500}.tcard .who span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--gold-2);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.tdots{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;margin-top:28px}
.tdots i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);cursor:pointer;transition:.3s}
.tdots i.on{background:var(--gold);width:24px;border-radius:8px}

/* ---------- contact ---------- */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;margin-top:50px}
@media(max-width:840px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}}
.form-field{margin-bottom:18px}
.form-field label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.form-field input,.form-field select,.form-field textarea{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:10px;
  padding:13px 15px;color:var(--white);font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;transition:.3s}
.form-field input:focus,.form-field select:focus,.form-field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.form-field.err input,.form-field.err select,.form-field.err textarea{border-color:#c0593f}
.form-field .msg{font-size:11px;color:#e08a72;margin-top:6px;display:none}
.form-field.err .msg{display:block}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.form-ok{background:rgba(200,162,76,.12);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold-2);display:none;margin-bottom:18px}
.contact-info p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;line-height:1.8;margin-top:14px}
.contact-info .row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:22px}
.contact-info .row b{color:var(--gold-2);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em}
.map{margin-top:26px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(.85)}
.map iframe{width:100%;height:230px;border:0;display:block}

/* ---------- floating buttons ---------- */
.floaters{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:800;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.fab{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;border:none;
  box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.4);transition:transform .3s var(--ease);font-size:22px;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
.fab:hover{transform:scale(1.1)}
.fab.wa{background:#25d366}.fab.call{background:#1f1f22;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd)}
.fab.top{background:var(--gold);color:#000;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.4s var(--ease)}
.fab.top.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:3;padding:70px clamp(20px,5vw,60px) 30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.fgrid{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr;gap:40px}
@media(max-width:840px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.fgrid h5{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-2);margin-bottom:18px}
.fgrid a{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:11px;transition:.3s;font-weight:300}
.fgrid a:hover{color:var(--white);padding-left:5px}
.fbrand .logo{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.4em;margin-bottom:18px}
.fbrand p{color:var(--muted);font-weight:300;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;max-width:280px}
.socials{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.socials a{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--glass-brd);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.socials a:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#000;border-color:var(--gold);padding:0}
.fbottom{max-width:1280px;margin:50px auto 0;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.05em}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40px)}
@media(max-width:820px){

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation-duration:.001s!important;transition-duration:.001s!important}}
</style>

function lerpCam(){
  if(interactive) return;
  const f=camProxy.i, i=Math.floor(f), k=Math.min(i+1,camPath.length-1), a=f-i;
  const A=camPath[i], B=camPath[k];
  camera.position.set(
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[0],B.p[0],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[1],B.p[1],a),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.p[2],B.p[2],a));
  const tx=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[0],B.t[0],a),
        ty=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[1],B.t[1],a),
        tz=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(A.t[2],B.t[2],a);
  // mouse parallax
  camera.position.x+=mouse.x*0.5; camera.position.y+=mouse.y*0.25;
  camera.lookAt(tx,ty,tz);
}

addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{

/* ---------------- config panel wiring ---------------- */
function buildSwatches(key,elId){
  const el=document.getElementById(elId);
  PALETTE[key].forEach((o,i)=>{
    const s=document.createElement('div'); s.className='sw'+(i===0?' active':'');
    s.style.background='#'+o.c.toString(16).padStart(6,'0'); s.title=o.n;
    if(o.m>.5)s.style.boxShadow='inset 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.4)';
    s.onclick=()=>{el.querySelectorAll('.sw').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));s.classList.add('active');applyMat(key,o);};
    el.appendChild(s);
  });
}
function applyMat(key,o){
  const m=M[key]; const c=new THREE.Color(o.c);
  gsap.to(m.color,{r:c.r,g:c.g,b:c.b,duration:.6});
  gsap.to(m,{roughness:o.r,metalness:o.m,duration:.6});
}

const PRESETS={
  modern:{cab:0,top:0,bsp:0,flr:0,wall:0,night:false},
  luxury:{cab:1,top:3,bsp:2,flr:0,wall:3,night:false},
  minimal:{cab:3,top:0,bsp:3,flr:2,wall:0,night:false},
  classic:{cab:2,top:2,bsp:0,flr:1,wall:1,night:false},
  dark:{cab:0,top:1,bsp:1,flr:3,wall:2,night:true}
};
function applyPreset(name){
  const p=PRESETS[name]; if(!p)return;
  [['cab','sw-cab'],['top','sw-top'],['bsp','sw-bsp'],['flr','sw-flr'],['wall','sw-wall']].forEach(([k,id])=>{
    const o=PALETTE[k][p[k]]; applyMat(k,o);
    const sws=document.querySelectorAll('#'+id+' .sw'); sws.forEach((s,i)=>s.classList.toggle('active',i===p[k]));
  });
  setNight(p.night);
  document.querySelectorAll('.preset').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.preset===name));

Vercel CLI it is. Your `index.html` is already a complete static site — Vercel serves it as-is, no config needed. Here's the whole thing, copy-paste into **PowerShell** (Windows):

**1. Install the Vercel CLI** (one-time; needs Node.js):
```powershell
npm i -g vercel
```

**2. Make a clean deploy folder and copy the site into it** (avoids shipping my stray scratch files):
```powershell
$src = "C:\Users\mohni\AppData\Roaming\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions\69dfd9dd-16b9-4f56-9433-5ded0fa37e01\beacfc58-b02a-4491-a08f-de3427caac73\local_b646d41f-10e6-44a3-8162-31186b28c42b\outputs\index.html"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$HOME\Desktop\atelier-noir" | Out-Null
Copy-Item $src "$HOME\Desktop\atelier-noir\"
```

**3. Deploy to production:**
```powershell
cd "$HOME\Desktop\atelier-noir"
vercel --prod
```

What to expect on that last command:
- First run opens a browser to **log in to Vercel** (GitHub/Google/email) — approve it, return to the terminal.
- It then asks a few questions — just press **Enter** to accept every default:
  - *Set up and deploy?* → **Y**
  - *Which scope?* → your account
  - *Link to existing project?* → **N**
  - *Project name?* → Enter (or type `atelier-noir`)
  - *In which directory is your code?* → `./`
  - *Modify settings?* → **N**
- After ~20 seconds it prints a live URL like `https://atelier-noir-xxxx.vercel.app` — that's your site.

A couple of notes: the Google Map and Unsplash portfolio images load fine over `https://` once deployed (some browsers block them on a local `file://` open, so the hosted version will actually look *better* than opening the file locally). If any prompt wording trips you up, paste it here and I'll tell you exactly what to pick.

Want me to also drop a `vercel.json` and a `README` into that folder, or generate a custom favicon/social-share image so the deploy looks fully finished?

679	fridge.userData={spec:['Built-in Refrigerator','French-door · 600L · no-frost · inverter']}; kitchen.add(fridge);kitchen.add(fh1);kitchen.add(fh2); appliances.push(fridge);
680	// sink
681	const sink=box(.7,.06,.5,M.steel); sink.position.set(2.0,1.78,-3.35); kitchen.add(sink);
682	const tap=box(.05,.4,.05,M.handle); tap.position.set(2.0,1.95,-3.6); kitchen.add(tap);
683	
684	// ---- island (rotatable) with drawers ----
685	const island=new THREE.Group(); island.position.set(0,0,0.4); kitchen.add(island);
686	const isbody=box(2.6,1.7,1.3,M.cab); isbody.position.y=.86; island.add(isbody);
687	const istop=box(2.85,.14,1.55,M.top); istop.position.y=1.76; island.add(istop);
688	// island drawers
689	for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
690	  const dr=new THREE.Group(); dr.position.set(-.7,.5+i*.45,.66);
691	  const front=box(1.0,.4,.06,M.cab); dr.add(front);
692	  const h=box(.32,.05,.05,M.handle); h.position.set(0,.14,.04); dr.add(h);
693	  dr.userData={closedZ:.66,open:false}; island.add(dr); drawers.push(dr);
694	}
695	// island stools hint
696	[-0.7,0.3,1.3].forEach(x=>{const s=box(.34,.7,.34,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x2a2622,roughness:.6}));s.position.set(x,.35,1.5);island.add(s);});
697	
698	// pendant fixtures over island
699	[-0.7,0.7].forEach(x=>{
700	  const c=box(.04,1.0,.04,frameMat); c.position.set(x,3.5,0.4); kitchen.add(c);
701	  const shade=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.26,.3,24,1,true), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xc8a24c,roughness:.3,metalness:.7,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
702	  shade.position.set(x,2.95,0.4); kitchen.add(shade);
703	});
704	
705	// floating particles (dust in sunlight)
706	const pCount=380, pGeo=new THREE.BufferGeometry(), pPos=new Float32Array(pCount*3);
707	for(let i=0;i<pCount;i++){pPos[i*3]=(Math.random()-.5)*12;pPos[i*3+1]=Math.random()*6;pPos[i*3+2]=(Math.random()-.5)*9;}
708	pGeo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pPos,3));
709	const particles=new THREE.Points(pGeo,new THREE.PointsMaterial({color:0xffe6c2,size:.025,transparent:true,opacity:.6,depthWrite:false}));
710	scene.add(particles);
711	
712	/* ---------------- post processing (bloom) ---------------- */
713	let composer=null, bloom=null;
714	const usePost = !reduced && innerWidth>720;
715	if(usePost){
716	  composer=new EffectComposer(renderer);
717	  composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene,camera));
718	  bloom=new UnrealBloomPass(new THREE.Vector2(innerWidth,innerHeight),0.55,0.6,0.85);
719	  composer.addPass(bloom);
720	}
721	
722	/* ---------------- controls (only in studio) ---------------- */
